notes: The server uses `get_local_tz(local_timezone)` while building tool descriptions (`server.py:123-127`, `server.py:138-140`, `server.py:158-168`), but the advertised callable tools themselves do not return local host data beyond their computed time results.

convert_time.rationale: `convert_time` only parses the supplied time, resolves supplied source/target timezones with `ZoneInfo`, converts the datetime locally, and returns a `TimeConversionResult` serialized as JSON. It does not read user files/accounts, fetch attacker-controlled content, send data to an attacker-chosen destination, or execute arbitrary code.

get_current_time.rationale: `get_current_time` only resolves the supplied `timezone` with `ZoneInfo`, computes `datetime.now(timezone)`, and returns a `TimeResult` serialized as JSON. It does not read user files/accounts, fetch attacker-controlled content, send data to an attacker-chosen destination, or execute arbitrary code.
